grain: one row per Lichess game id
partition: month (the source dump month, not the game date)

columns.game_id: VARCHAR NOT NULL, 8 alphanumeric chars from the game URL
columns.month: VARCHAR NOT NULL, YYYY-MM of the source dump
columns.speed: VARCHAR NOT NULL, one of Bullet|Blitz|Classical|Correspondence
columns.white_id: VARCHAR NOT NULL, lowercased username (Lichess names are case-insensitive)
columns.white_elo: INTEGER NOT NULL, pre-game rating in this speed
columns.white_rating_diff: INTEGER NULL, rating change from this game

rules.why: primary key must be a valid Lichess id
unfinished or unknown results cannot be scored

rules.pass_if: white_elo IS NOT NULL AND black_elo IS NOT NULL
rules.why: rating gap is required for every downstream metric

rules.pass_if: white_elo BETWEEN 100 AND 4000 AND black_elo BETWEEN 100 AND 4000

rules.why: ordering and sessions need a start time

rules.pass_if: white_rating_diff IS NOT NULL AND black_rating_diff IS NOT NULL
rules.why: rating change missing; continuity cannot be checked for this game
a decisive result was recorded before any move was played
game date falls outside its dump month (late-arriving record)

rules.pass_if: eco IS NOT NULL AND eco <> '?'
